A '''tapestry''' depicting the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Adari Vaal]] hung from the walls of [[Vaal Hall]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the government of the continent of [[Alanciar]]. Behind the tapestry was an entrance to [[Library of Adari Vaal|Vaal's secret library]], wherein was stored the ''[[Keshtah Chronicles]]'' and [[Adari's personal memoirs|Adari Vaal's personal memoirs]].
